name: tduck
description: 用自然语言在 TDuck（tduck.com）上搭建表单与数据收集：创建、复制、编辑表单与题目结构，批量增删改查填报数据，管理归档文件夹，一键发布与停止收集，替代登录后台手动操作。
descriptionEn: Build forms and collect data on TDuck (tduck.com) with natural language: create, copy, and edit forms and question structures, batch manage submission entries, organize folders, and publish or stop collection with ease.
